QF.id: IV Clearing Settlement and Risk Management_8

question.text: A futures contract has a settlement price of Rs. 102.00, conversion factor of 0.95, and accrued interest of Rs. 1.50 per unit. For 5 lots of 2,000 units each, what is the invoice amount under physical delivery using IA = [(SP x CF) + AI] x CA / 100?

explanation.text: The Logic: Apply the workbook formula IA = [(SP x CF) + AI] x CA / 100 where CA is the contract / face amount. Face amount = 5 lots x 2,000 units = 10,000 units = Rs. 10,00,000 face value. IA = [(102 x 0.95) + 1.50] x 10,00,000 / 100 = (96.90 + 1.50) x 10,000 = 98.40 x 10,000 = Rs. 9,84,000. The Trap: Rs. 10,35,000 results from ignoring the conversion factor entirely (102 + 1.50) x 10,000 / something equivalent. Rs. 10,84,000 was an arithmetic slip in earlier explanations. Rs. 9,69,000 drops the accrued interest. The formula requires both CF and AI. Note: Page 250 sets out the invoice-amount formula. Page 238 notes that currently traded ETIRD in India are cash-settled, even though the physical-delivery formula is still presented in the workbook for completeness.
